situations.title: 간부전 사정·의식 관찰
situations.tagline: He's so confused today — he didn't even recognize me.
situations.brief: 간부전 환자의 의식과 간성뇌증 등급을 사정하고 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: Confusion can come from the liver affecting the brain.
I'll check how alert and oriented he is now.
Please tell me if he becomes more sleepy or agitated.
goals: 의식 변화를 가족 관찰과 함께 추적한다

situations.title: 암모니아·응고·간효소 추적
situations.tagline: What do all these liver blood tests actually tell you?
situations.brief: 암모니아와 응고, 간효소 지표를 추적하고 그 의미를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: These tests show how your liver is working right now.
The ammonia level relates to the confusion we watch for.
We repeat them to see if you're improving.

situations.title: 락툴로오스 투여·배변 관리
situations.tagline: This medicine is making me go to the bathroom constantly — is that on purpose?
situations.brief: 락툴로오스 투여와 배변 관리로 간성뇌증을 치료하는 원리를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, the medicine helps clear the toxins through your bowels.
We aim for a few soft stools a day.
It's an important part of clearing the confusion.

situations.title: 출혈 경향 감시
situations.tagline: I keep getting bruises and my gums bleed — why is that happening?
situations.brief: 간부전에 따른 응고장애와 출혈 경향을 감시하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Your liver makes clotting factors, and it's struggling now.
We watch closely for any bruising or bleeding.
Please tell me about any new bleeding right away.

situations.title: 저혈당·전해질 감시
situations.tagline: Her glucose is running low — do you want to recheck and start dextrose?
situations.brief: 간부전의 대사 불안정에서 저혈당과 전해질을 감시하고 교정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's recheck the glucose and give dextrose if it's low.
I'll monitor her electrolytes closely.
Her liver can't keep the sugar stable on its own.

situations.title: 감염 징후 감시
situations.tagline: His belly's tender and he's spiking a fever — could this be SBP?
situations.brief: 자발성 세균성 복막염 등 감염 징후를 조기에 감시하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Fever and belly tenderness can mean SBP.
Let's get cultures and consider a diagnostic tap.
I'll notify the physician and start the workup.
goals: SBP 등 감염 징후를 조기에 인지한다

situations.title: 간성뇌증 단계별 관리
situations.tagline: What made his confusion suddenly get this bad?
situations.brief: 간성뇌증의 유발인자를 찾아 교정하며 단계별로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Things like infection or bleeding can worsen the confusion.
We're looking for the trigger and treating it.
The lactulose and other steps should help him clear.

situations.title: 응고장애·출혈 위험 관리
situations.tagline: He needs a line placed, but his INR is high — how do we manage the bleeding risk?
situations.brief: 시술 전 응고장애를 교정하며 출혈 위험을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's correct with products just before the procedure.
I'll have blood available and hold pressure carefully.
We'll recheck the coags and watch for bleeding.

situations.title: 뇌부종 위험 감시
situations.tagline: In acute liver failure, could his brain be swelling — should we watch the ICP signs?
situations.brief: 급성 간부전에서 뇌부종과 두개내압 상승 위험을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's watch his neuro exam and pupils closely.
Keep his head elevated and avoid spikes in pressure.
I'll alert the team if his mental status worsens.

situations.title: 간신증후군 감시
situations.tagline: His kidneys are shutting down despite fluids — I'm worried about hepatorenal syndrome.
situations.brief: 간신증후군을 의심하며 신기능과 수액 반응을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's track his urine output and creatinine trend.
We may need albumin and specific medications.
I'll notify the physician about the falling output.

situations.title: 이식 평가 연계
situations.tagline: The team mentioned a transplant — how do we even get on the list?
situations.brief: 간이식 평가 연계와 등록, 시급성을 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The transplant team will evaluate whether he's a candidate.
His severity score helps decide the urgency.
I'll help connect you with the transplant coordinator.

situations.title: 원인별 치료
situations.tagline: This looks like acetaminophen toxicity — should we start the NAC drip?
situations.brief: 아세트아미노펜 중독 등 원인에 맞춰 NAC 등 치료를 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, let's start the NAC infusion per protocol.
I'll confirm the dosing and monitor for reactions.
Early treatment gives the liver the best chance.
goals: 원인에 맞춰 NAC 등 치료를 신속히 시작한다

situations.title: 감염 예방·조기 치료
situations.tagline: He's so prone to infection right now — are we on top of the sepsis screening?
situations.brief: 패혈증에 취약한 간부전 환자에서 감염 예방과 조기 치료를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's keep up strict hand hygiene and line care.
I'll watch his vitals and labs for early sepsis.
We'll start antibiotics quickly if signs appear.
goals: 조기 패혈증 징후를 감시하고 치료를 앞당긴다

situations.title: 영양·단백 관리
situations.tagline: Should I be avoiding protein, or eating more of it?
situations.brief: 근감소와 암모니아를 고려한 영양과 단백 섭취를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We usually keep protein up to protect your muscles.
We adjust it carefully based on your ammonia.
A dietitian will tailor a plan for you.
goals: 단백 섭취와 근감소 예방의 균형을 설명한다

situations.title: 약물 대사·용량 조정
situations.tagline: His liver can't clear these meds well — should we adjust the dosing?
situations.brief: 간청소 저하를 고려해 약물 대사와 용량을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's review which meds need dose adjustment.
We should avoid drugs that are hard on the liver.
I'll flag any sedatives that could worsen confusion.
goals: 간청소 저하에 맞춰 약물 용량을 조정한다

situations.title: 급성 간부전 뇌부종 뇌탈출 위기
situations.tagline: His ICP is spiking and a pupil's sluggish — let's give hypertonic saline now.
situations.brief: 급성 간부전 뇌부종의 뇌탈출 위기에서 삼투요법과 에스컬레이션을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Give the hypertonic saline and elevate his head.
I'm calling neuro and the physician immediately.
Let's control his CO2 and keep him still.

situations.title: 대량 출혈·응고붕괴 위기
situations.tagline: He's bleeding from everywhere and his coags have collapsed — we need products fast.
situations.brief: 응고붕괴를 동반한 대량 출혈에서 성분수혈로 신속히 소생하세요.
keyPhrases: Get plasma, platelets, and cryo now.
Transfuse in balanced ratios and keep him warm.
Recheck fibrinogen and coags frequently.

situations.title: 급성 의식저하 기도 위기
situations.tagline: His mental status just dropped — he can't protect his airway, let's intubate.
situations.brief: 급성 의식저하로 기도가 위태로운 환자를 신속히 확보하고 삽관을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get the intubation tray and suction ready.
Let's preoxygenate and position his airway.
Suction is on and I'm ready to assist.

situations.title: 다장기부전 진행 위기
situations.tagline: His kidneys, lungs, and pressure are all failing at once — this is spiraling.
situations.brief: 다장기부전으로 진행하는 위기에서 우선순위를 정해 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's prioritize his pressure and oxygenation now.
I'm escalating to the physician for more support.
We may need dialysis and higher vent settings.

situations.title: 응급 이식 조율 위기
situations.tagline: He's listed as status 1A — the transplant center wants him transferred now.
situations.brief: 시급 등록 환자의 응급 이식을 위해 이송과 조율을 신속히 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's stabilize him for immediate transfer.
I'll give a full handoff to the transplant center.
Bring blood and emergency meds for the trip.
goals: 응급 이식을 위한 이송을 신속히 준비한다

situations.title: 이식 불가 목표·완화 소통
situations.tagline: They said he's not a candidate for a transplant — does that mean there's nothing left?
situations.brief: 이식 불가 상황에서 치료 목표와 완화 돌봄을 가족과 진솔하게 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: It means transplant isn't a safe option for him.
But there is still a lot we can do to keep him comfortable.
Let's talk about what would matter most to him.
goals: 완화 돌봄과 치료 목표를 가족과 논의한다
